officialStatement.definition: 节点图变量是一种生命周期跟随节点图的变量（仅在_服务端节点图_中可用）
officialStatement.hardRestriction: SERVER-SIDE NODE GRAPHS ONLY. Client and skill graphs cannot carry them.
officialStatement.scope: 节点图变量仅在节点图变量所在的节点图内可以进行访问（设置、获取以及监听事件）
officialStatement.entityOverride: when a graph is mounted on an entity the entity holds these variables, but they can only be set/read/listened from INSIDE that same graph. Level-level involvement is limited to OVERRIDING values, not accessing them.
officialStatement.types: 所有基础和列表数据类型 - identical to custom variables. No size or nesting constraint stated.
officialStatement.editorEntry: the 节点图变量 tab, opened from 在节点图编辑页面-快捷菜单栏
operationsDocumented: 修改已配置的节点图变量
drag a variable into the edit area for a quick-create menu offering set and get nodes
设置值、获取值、监听变化
officialStatement.theExposureMechanism: 点击节点图变量前的对外暴露按钮后保存节点图 - a 对外暴露 (expose-externally) toggle must be turned on and the graph SAVED before the variable can be overridden on an entity
whatIsNOTDocumented: an explicit DELETE/remove operation for a graph variable
whether values persist across sessions - the only lifecycle statement is that it follows the graph

节点图变量.定义域: 仅在定义该变量的节点图内可访问
节点图变量.实体覆写: 可以，但需要手动将其对外暴露

自定义变量.定义域: 全局可访问，需要指明访问的实体
自定义变量.命名: 同组件（实体）内不可重名
自定义变量.实体覆写: 可以，遵循通用的组件参数覆写规则

statedAdvantages: defined and used inside 千星沙箱
same-named ones may coexist on one entity if they sit in different graphs
graph-specific data stays unexposed, reducing reading difficulty
lets a creator encapsulate graph functionality without knowing which entity it will mount on
officialStatement.recommendedUsage: entity-level globally-readable data (e.g. a mechanism's hit count) goes in 自定义变量; graph-local temporary data (e.g. a cached player list) goes in 节点图变量

note: recorded only to state which graph sides a graph variable can exist on
